Top executives highlighted how the acquisition fits into a broader digital services strategy that already includes microfinance, insurance products like JazzSure, and modern coverage options via FikrFree. Representatives emphasized that the integration process will prioritize seamless customer continuity and steady coordination across all banking teams.

stories.title: Pakistan Tanners Association Requests Slaughterhouses and Wastewater Plant Revival
stories.summary:
Representatives from Pakistan's leather industry met with Punjab Provincial Minister for Industries and Commerce Chaudhry Shafay Hussain to discuss ongoing raw material shortages and environmental compliance hurdles. Malik Muhammad Azam, Chairman of the Pakistan Tanners Association, led the industry delegation during the Thursday discussions.

During the talks, the delegation stressed that the scarcity of raw hides severely hurts export potential and recommended that the provincial government construct organized slaughterhouses to ease supply bottlenecks. Additionally, the association requested official assistance to restore the dysfunctional wastewater treatment facility located in Kasur.

Minister Shafay acknowledged the sector's vital role in national exports and promised prompt attention to the group's grievances. He reminded attendees of their environmental obligations, urging factories to adopt strict wastewater treatment protocols to safeguard natural resources for future generations. He also noted that businesses can utilize government financing schemes, including interest-free loans through the Asaan Karobar Finance Scheme, by applying via the Bank of Punjab.

To address workforce shortages, the minister suggested partnering with the Skills Development Department. Meanwhile, the PTA delegation outlined plans to open new trade promotion centers in Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, and Kazakhstan to expand international market reach.

stories.title: Pakistan Faces Severe Climate Crises and Demands Comprehensive Domestic Action
stories.summary:
Toxic smog continues to choke Punjab, with Lahore recording a hazardous air quality index of 358 on Wednesday, highlighting an escalating environmental crisis. While authorities note that improved monitoring has slightly mitigated pollution compared to past years, dangerous air conditions persist alongside regional transboundary haze and heavy domestic emissions.

Beyond air pollution, Pakistan remains highly vulnerable to interconnected climate hazards, including recurrent flooding, extreme heatwaves, and severe water scarcity. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif recently highlighted positive developments at COP31, noting the addition of roughly 22 gigawatts of rooftop solar capacity driven by citizens seeking relief from high electricity costs. The nation has also committed to increasing electricity's share in total energy use to 35 per cent by 2035 and raising electric vehicle sales to 30 per cent by 2030.

Despite these energy transitions, experts stress that long-term resilience requires comprehensive adaptation strategies beyond emissions targets. Critical needs include protecting vulnerable communities from floods, securing water supplies, adapting agricultural practices, and enforcing strict industrial and vehicular emission standards. The government continues to advocate for international climate justice, demanding concessional financing and affordable technology from wealthy industrialized nations historically responsible for global warming.

Domestically, addressing these crises requires cooperation across federal and provincial levels, alongside active participation from businesses and citizens. Analysts warn that delaying comprehensive environmental reforms carries a heavy toll in lost livelihoods, widespread illness, and continuous economic disruption.

stories.title: سلامتی کونسل کا یمن پابندیوں میں توسیع، حوثی گروپ کے حملوں کی مذمت
stories.summary:
اقوام متحدہ کی سلامتی کونسل نے ایک قرارداد منظور کر کے یمن سے متعلق پابندیوں میں مزید ایک سال کی توسیع کر دی ہے۔ اس فیصلے کے تحت افراد اور اداروں کے اثاثے منجمد کرنے اور سفری پابندیوں کے اقدامات کو 14 نومبر 2027 تک بڑھا دیا گیا ہے۔ اجلاس کے دوران سعودی عرب پر حوثی گروپ کے حملوں کی شدید مذمت بھی کی گئی۔

سلامتی کونسل نے حوثیوں پر زور دیا ہے کہ وہ شہریوں، تجارتی ہوائی اڈوں اور بین الاقوامی بحری گزرگاہوں پر اپنی فوجی کارروائیاں فوری طور پر بند کریں۔ اقوام متحدہ میں برطانیہ کی مستقل مندوب سارہ میکنٹوش نے کہا کہ اس قرارداد سے اسلحے کی پابندی مزید مؤثر ہوگی اور ہتھیاروں کی تیاری میں استعمال ہونے والے خام کیمیکلز پر کڑی نظر رکھی جائے گی۔

ادھر متحدہ عرب امارات کے علاقے فجیرہ میں ایک بے قابو ٹرک کے کئی گاڑیوں سے ٹکرانے کے حادثے میں 14 افراد ہلاک اور متعدد زخمی ہو گئے۔ اس حادثے میں 23 گاڑیاں متاثر ہوئیں اور ٹرک میں لگنے والی آگ دیگر گاڑیوں تک پھیل گئی۔ فجیرہ پولیس کے مطابق زخمیوں کو ہسپتال منتقل کیا گیا جن میں مختلف ممالک کے شہری شامل ہیں۔

دوسری جانب امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے سوشل میڈیا پر بیان دیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ امریکہ کو ایران کے ساتھ کسی معاہدے کی ضرورت نہیں ہے۔ انھوں نے نائب صدر جے ڈی وینس کو ڈیموکریٹک ریاستوں میں بڑے پیمانے پر بدعنوانی اور جرائم پر توجہ مرکوز کرنے کی ہدایت بھی جاری کی ہے۔

stories.title: PTI Chairman Gohar Ali Khan Visits Hospitalized Shah Mahmood Qureshi
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf Chairman Gohar Ali Khan visited the Punjab Institute of Cardiology in Lahore to check on senior party figure Shah Mahmood Qureshi. Accompanied by MNA Zain Qureshi, Gohar shared an image of the hospital visit on social media. Qureshi had been transferred to the medical facility following a fainting episode and subsequent fall inside Kot Lakhpat jail.

According to defense counsel Rana Mudassar Umar, the former foreign minister collapsed shortly before the incident became public. He remained under medical observation at the institute for 24 hours while physicians evaluated whether formal hospital admission was required. Available documentation did not specify his discharge status or subsequent treatment plan, prompting strong health apprehensions from his relatives.

Zain Qureshi stated that his father lost consciousness while walking inside his barracks, urging prison administrators to organize a CT scan and a dental appointment to address a cracked tooth sustained during the fall. Simultaneously, Qureshi's daughter, Meher Bano, expressed profound anxiety online, requesting prayers and his release while highlighting previous medical complications, including a gallbladder removal in December and a cardiac scare in May.

The PTI core committee condemned the deterioration of Qureshi's health and demanded that government entities, courts, and prison officials facilitate adequate medical attention and a complete hospital transfer. Imprisoned since August 2023, Qureshi confronts several legal accusations tied to the May 9 riots, featuring an indictment by a Lahore anti-terrorism court in July 2024 regarding an assault on the Shadman Police Station, while his relatives and legal team assert he has endured unjustified legal hurdles.

stories.title: Pakistan Football Federation Overhauls Constitution to Satisfy FIFA Conditions
stories.summary:
Following nearly eight years of institutional breakdown, the Pakistan Football Federation is drafting a structural revision of its constitution to fulfill FIFA regulations and unlock international funding. PFF delegates briefed the National Assembly Standing Committee on Inter-Provincial Coordination, headed by Dr. Mahreen Razzaq Bhutto, detailing that FIFA intervened in internal matters, supervised elections, and acknowledged the outcomes.

The organization submitted its charter to FIFA for evaluation, with final recommendations anticipated by December 2026, allowing the PFF to finalize adjustments during the first quarter of 2027. Officials emphasized that monetary assistance and grants from FIFA depend entirely on adherence to global governance criteria. Furthermore, the federation requested FIFA backing to establish a football academy in Quetta.

Committee participants urged that athletic infrastructure and soccer programs be extended beyond the provincial capital to additional districts across Balochistan. The panel also reviewed the implications of the 18th Constitutional Amendment on tourism oversight, noting that parallel provincial registration frameworks for travel agencies created administrative hurdles. The Department of Tourist Services maintains jurisdiction within the Islamabad Capital Territory.

Legislators instructed the tourism department to furnish audit records of state-run travel agencies, fee collection figures, and a register detailing certified tourist guides and their spoken languages. Additionally, the committee learned that over 80 percent of sports-related administration and budgets have been transferred to provincial governments, leaving federal authorities primarily with supervisory duties.

stories.title: FBR Establishes Tax Stamp Costs for Cement Producers Across Pakistan
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue has established the pricing for tax stamps applicable to cement manufacturers at Rs1,140.64 per 1,000 Unique Identification Marks. This rate incorporates an extra fee of Rs165.64 designated to cover annual maintenance expenses for the track and trace infrastructure.

Released via a notification from the Directorate General of Information Technology and Digital Transformation, the pricing follows Rule 150ZQH of Chapter XIV-B outlined in the Sales Tax Rules of 2006. The directive outlines that the additional charge of Rs165.64 is levied on top of the base cost of Rs975 per 1,000 UIMs to reach the final cement sector rate. The extra fee addresses yearly maintenance service expenses totaling Rs99,385,831 covering the service cycle from September 2026 through August 2027.

The FBR explained that the directive followed a Licensing Committee determination from April 30, 2025, and a subsequent letter issued on November 5, 2026. This extra fee remains active for a 12-month period from the notification date or until the licensee distributes 600 million UIMs to cement producers, whichever event occurs first.

Upon the conclusion of the designated timeframe or achievement of the target sales volume, the price will decrease back to the standard base rate of Rs975 per 1,000 UIMs unless alternative instructions are issued. The FBR has granted its licensee formal permission to collect the mandated charges from cement producers.

stories.title: Chief Justice Invites Bar Nominations to Evaluate Draft E-Filing System
stories.summary:
Chief Justice of Pakistan Justice Yahya Afridi requested provincial bar councils and the Islamabad Bar Council to designate two representatives each to assess draft e-filing frameworks and propose enhancements prior to a pilot rollout. Serving as Chairperson of the National Judicial Policy Making Committee, Justice Afridi convened a consultation with delegates from provincial bars, the Islamabad Bar Council, and the Supreme Court Bar Association of Pakistan.

The session centered on the proposed family case e-filing pilot and the creation of Women Facilitation Centres. Discussions evaluated draft e-filing documents created under the proposed National Unified E-Filing and Electronic Judicial Record System, designed for initial testing in family disputes across designated judicial locations. Stressing the necessity of engaging the legal community, the Chief Justice highlighted that an efficient and user-friendly platform must be shaped by the practical insights of active advocates.

Bar delegates praised both the e-filing initiative and the facilitation centers, acknowledging their capacity to enhance justice accessibility, particularly for women, and streamline family court procedures. The dialogue underscored a collective dedication to judicial modernization through technology. Separately, the Chief Justice led a meeting at the Supreme Court as Chairman of the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan to evaluate progress on nationwide Women Facilitation Centres.

The initial rollout will feature four units, one in each province, designed to offer female litigants specialized guidance in a safe environment. Justice Afridi established the deployment of these centers across all provinces and Islamabad as a key objective for the 2026–27 period, operating as centralized hubs to spare women from visiting multiple offices.

stories.title: Anti-Terrorism Court Records Statements of Witnesses in PAF Officer Murder Case
stories.summary:
An anti-terrorism court in Islamabad on Thursday proceeded with the murder case of Pakistan Air Force Group Captain Asim Tariq, recording the testimony of three more prosecution witnesses. Presiding Judge Abul Hasanat Zulqarnain conducted the hearing, during which prosecutor Raja Naveed Hussain represented the state.

Following the latest testimonies, the judicial body has officially documented the statements of 13 prosecution witnesses. The court instructed the defense attorneys to carry out the cross-examination of these witnesses during the upcoming court session and issued summons for all remaining witnesses to appear and give their statements.

The proceedings were subsequently adjourned until November 16. The high-profile murder took place on July 5 within the official boundaries of the Margalla Police Station.

In the wake of the incident, local law enforcement filed a First Information Report based on an official complaint lodged by Wing Commander Imran Khurram Nawaz, who serves as the Officer Commanding at the Air Headquarters. The case has been registered under Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code, which pertains to murder, alongside Section 7 of the Anti-Terrorism Act.

stories.title: Federal Minister Ahsan Iqbal Seeks Recommendations to Revamp National Education System
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal called upon educational experts and teachers on Thursday to contribute practical recommendations and personal experiences. The minister stated that this feedback is essential to ensure that government reform efforts are effective, realistic, and responsive to the needs of educational institutions and students.

Speaking during a visit to IMCG Golra Girls’ School as part of the Islamabad Capital Territory Education Reforms initiative, the minister noted that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif directed the administration to establish Islamabad's education network as a benchmark model for the rest of the country. He emphasized that national advancement in a modern knowledge-driven era relies on intellectual capacity and creativity rather than physical labor.

The federal official explained that the strategy aims to turn existing facilities into high-performance centers rather than removing individuals from the system, while ensuring equitable access to quality education nationwide. He criticized colonial-era educational practices for encouraging rote memorization and stressed the necessity of fostering critical thinking, research, problem-solving, and early childhood development.

Urging instructors to move beyond standard curriculum delivery, Iqbal stated that classrooms must evolve into hubs of inquiry and independent thought. He added that the broader initiative focuses on substantive teaching improvements and ground-level engagement with educators rather than merely making administrative adjustments.

stories.title: Minister Ahsan Iqbal Proposes Joint Working Group for Balochistan Mining and Infrastructure Projects
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal proposed the creation of a joint working group on Thursday to accelerate development projects in Balochistan. The proposed group would bring together the Ministry of Planning, the National Highway Authority, the Balochistan government, and mining companies to finalize technical feasibility studies and financing requirements.

During a meeting with senior executives from Barrick Mining Corporation in Islamabad, the minister emphasized the urgency of fast-tracking the Nokundi–Gwadar road corridor. He noted that connecting the mineral-rich regions of Balochistan to ports through efficient transport networks is vital for unlocking the nation's mineral export potential and attracting further investments.

To expedite the project, Iqbal called for detailed topographical and three-dimensional mapping data to support feasibility assessments for missing infrastructure links. Representatives from Barrick Mining Corporation expressed support for the cooperative approach, discussing logistics planning and regulatory coordination needed for the corridor.

The discussions align with Pakistan's National Economic Transformation Plan 2035, which targets one hundred billion dollars in exports, with the minerals sector playing a major role. The minister reiterated the government's commitment to facilitating foreign investments and upgrading critical national logistics.

stories.title: Canadian Mining Firm Signs Memorandum of Understanding with Pakistan's Mari Energies
stories.summary:
Canadian enterprise Ivanhoe Mines entered into a memorandum of understanding with Pakistan-based Mari Energies on Thursday. Chairman Robert Friedland announced the agreement on the sidelines of the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum, noting that the firm is currently establishing a local office and plans to execute another memorandum on Friday.

Through its mining subsidiary Mari Minerals, the Pakistani partner manages multiple mineral exploration ventures across the country, focusing on commodities such as copper and gold. This agreement represents Ivanhoe Mines' first expansion into South Asia, broadening its geographical footprint beyond extensive operations in southern Africa.

The development coincides with broader governmental initiatives in Pakistan to court foreign investors for its mineral sector. Last year, authorities announced plans to offer specific concessions to United States companies during tariff negotiations.

Meanwhile, the sector continues to navigate operational challenges. Earlier in the year, gold producer Barrick Mining extended its strategic review regarding the large-scale Reko Diq copper-gold deposit, citing security concerns across the Middle East and South Asia.

stories.title: Benazir Income Support Programme Launches Interoperable Digital Payment System
stories.summary:
The Benazir Income Support Programme has introduced an interoperable payment mechanism across Pakistan to distribute financial aid to female beneficiaries through six selected financial institutions. Disbursements have begun via Habib Bank Limited, HBL Microfinance Bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Bank Alfalah, and Bank of Punjab. The initiative aims to provide recipients with flexible banking options, minimize lengthy waiting lines, eliminate unauthorized deductions, and enhance overall transparency and accountability.

BISP Chairperson Senator Rubina Khalid met with State Bank of Pakistan Governor Jameel Ahmad to review the rollout and future strategy of the digital disbursement framework. During the meeting, which was also attended by BISP Additional Secretary Dr. Ismat Nawaz, Senator Khalid praised the central bank for its assistance in onboarding the six financial partners and supporting the digital infrastructure.

Senator Khalid emphasized that the updated framework ensures women can securely access their monetary support through their preferred financial institutions. She reiterated the organization's dedication to advancing financial inclusion while maintaining a transparent and respectful distribution process. Furthermore, she confirmed that collaboration with the State Bank and associated financial partners will persist to guarantee effective execution.

The launch marks a significant step in modernizing the welfare delivery mechanism for millions of women throughout the country. By utilizing multiple banking channels, BISP seeks to streamline operations and empower beneficiaries with greater control over their financial assistance.

stories.title: Sindh Government Plans Comprehensive Crackdown on Karachi Road Encroachments
stories.summary:
The Sindh government has approved a coordinated initiative to clear illegal encroachments along primary thoroughfares in Karachi, focusing on University Road and transit corridors used by the People’s Bus Service. The measure aims to alleviate severe traffic congestion and facilitate the smooth operation of public transit systems across the metropolitan area.

The decision was finalized during a high-level session headed by Sindh Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon. Attendees included Karachi Commissioner Syed Hassan Naqvi, Transport Secretary Asad Zamin, Karachi Police Chief Azad Khan, DIG Traffic Pir Muhammad Shah, DIG East Farrukh Lanjar, and other key administrative personnel.

Authorities agreed that the police, municipal administration, and transport sector will collaboratively dismantle unauthorized structures impeding traffic flow. Additionally, the administration resolved to relocate unauthorized transit facilities, including the bus terminal located at Sohrab Goth, to sites situated outside city limits.

Sharjeel Memon highlighted that roadside blockages and unauthorized terminals exacerbate traffic delays, elevate fuel consumption, and distress daily travelers. Consequently, he instructed relevant agencies to synchronize their enforcement operations. The gathering also reviewed proposals for constructing contemporary bus terminals outside the city under Public-Private Partnerships, expanding the Karachi Bus Terminal, and accelerating the Logistics Park initiative.

stories.title: UBG and BMPP Form Alliance to Contest FPCCI Elections Together
stories.summary:
The United Business Group and the Businessmen Panel Progressive have formally announced a joint electoral strategy for the upcoming Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry leadership polls. Representatives from both factions declared that their four-year-old coalition will persist in collaborating to elevate the FPCCI's institutional prestige and deploy a competent economic team.

During a media briefing held at the Korangi Association of Trade and Industry on Thursday, UBG Patron-in-Chief and FPCCI presidential nominee S.M. Tanveer, alongside BMPP Chairman Saquib Fayyaz Magoon, unveiled a strategic 100-day agenda designed to resolve commercial challenges nationwide. Magoon officially confirmed the BMPP's unconditional endorsement of Tanveer for the presidency, expressing confidence in his vision and dismissing opposition claims regarding his local affiliation by highlighting his memberships in Karachi trade and cultural bodies.

Tanveer asserted that he commands widespread backing from the business community across Islamabad, Karachi, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab, and Balochistan. He emphasized that the partnership between UBG and BMPP remains unbreakable and that elected members will be entrusted with leadership positions in various committees to effectively articulate sector-specific grievances. He stressed that empowering businesses will naturally generate vital employment opportunities for the public.

UFG President Zubair Tufail lauded Tanveer's consistent advocacy for industrial and commercial interests over the past three years. Tufail also commended Saqib Fayyaz Magoon for his commendable three-year tenure as Senior Vice President, reinforcing the unity and strength of the coalition moving forward.

stories.title: Repair Work Underway Around the Clock Following Rock Collapse at Tarbela T-5
stories.summary:
Civil engineering crews are working around the clock to repair a crater formed by a weak rock mass collapse within the intake pit area of the Tarbela Dam 5th Extension Hydropower Project. The incident occurred during excavation work on the 2nd Bench Connecting Tunnel, allowing water from the intake pit to surge into the tunnel and powerhouse construction zone. Project officials confirmed that all personnel present during the routine activities were safely evacuated immediately following the collapse.

Authorities from the Tarbela project and the Haripur district administration stated that the intake pit has been completely cleared of water, halting further flow into downstream work areas while dewatering of the under-construction powerhouse proceeds. Officials noted that the structural integrity of the main tunnel, powerhouse, tailrace culvert, and switchyard remained unaffected by the rock failure. Wapda teams, consultants, and contractors rapidly deployed heavy-duty pumping equipment and initiated concrete pouring operations to seal the cavity, with completion expected within a week.

Preliminary assessment reports compiled by geology and seismology specialists have been forwarded to the Wapda chairman and the Ministry of Water Resources, with a comprehensive final report slated for the Prime Minister's Office. Geologists maintained that the incident resulted from a damaged rock mass situated behind an intact diversion plug, ruling out human error or engineering defects. While specialized equipment operators continue round-the-clock restoration efforts, most of the project's 3,000 workers have been advised to remain at home until further notice.

stories.title: Pakistan State Oil and Kuwait Petroleum Expand Fifty-Year Partnership
stories.summary:
Pakistan State Oil (PSO) and Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) have agreed to broaden their five-decade energy relationship during a recent meeting between senior officials from both companies in Karachi.

The PSO delegation was led by Chief Executive Officer Jawwad Ahmed Cheema, alongside Vice President Consumer Business Ghulam Murtaza Shaikh and General Manager Supply Ashar Ansar. They met with KPC Chief Executive Officer and Deputy Chairman Shaikh Nawaf Saud Al-Sabah, as well as Managing Director International Marketing Shaikh Khaled Ahmad Al-Sabah, who also serves as the chief executive officer of the Kuwait Oil Tanker Company.

Under the updated arrangements, the two corporations will maintain their existing gasoil and jet fuel supply terms from Kuwait to Pakistan while optimizing conditions to match current market trends. Additionally, both sides plan to investigate potential supplies of motor gasoline, petrochemicals, base oils, and lubricants, alongside utilizing Pakistan's port and storage infrastructure through a newly revised Customs Bonded Storage Policy.

This expanded collaboration matters because it transitions the relationship from traditional fuel shipments to a comprehensive strategic alliance encompassing refining, shipping, logistics, and infrastructure investments. The partnership aims to enhance Pakistan's energy security and promote regional trade.

To commemorate the half-century milestone, PSO has invited KPC's senior leadership to visit Pakistan early next year. PSO praised the Pakistani government and Petroleum Division for introducing crucial policy reforms that continue to draw international investments into the domestic energy market.

stories.title: اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ نے بلدیاتی انتخابات کا شیڈول معطل کرنے کی درخواستوں پر فیصلہ محفوظ کر لیا
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ نے اسلام آباد میں بلدیاتی انتخابات رکوانے اور اس کا شیڈول معطل کرنے سے متعلق دائر درخواستوں پر سماعت مکمل کرنے کے بعد اپنا فیصلہ محفوظ کر لیا ہے۔ سماعت کے دوران وکیل کی جانب سے مؤقف اختیار کیا گیا کہ اگر الیکشن شیڈول معطل نہیں کیا گیا تو امیدواروں کے کروڑوں روپے ضائع ہو جائیں گے۔ اس پر جسٹس عمیر مجید ملک نے ریمارکس دیے کہ اگر کوئی شخص انتخابی مہم پر اتنی بڑی رقم خرچ کرتا ہے تو اس میں عدالت کیا کر سکتی ہے؟ انہوں نے اسے ایک الارمنگ صورتحال قرار دیا۔

اسی دوران ملک کے دیگر سیاسی اور انتظامی امور سے متعلق بھی اہم بیانات سامنے آئے ہیں۔ وزیر اعظم کے مشیر برائے سیاسی امور رانا ثنا اللہ نے اس تاثر کو مسترد کیا ہے کہ 28ویں آئینی ترمیم کے حوالے سے کوئی خصوصی ملاقات کروائی گئی تھی۔ وفاقی وزیر ڈاکٹر طارق فضل چوہدری نے واضح کیا ہے کہ بانی پی ٹی آئی کے تمام مقدمات اور معاملات عدالتوں کے ذریعے ہی حل کیے جائیں گے۔ تحریک انصاف کے رہنما علی محمد خان نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ بیرسٹر گوہر اور محسن نقوی کے درمیان رابطے رہے ہیں، جن میں سیاسی امور، ملکی سیکیورٹی اور نئے صوبوں کے قیام پر بات چیت کی گئی ہے۔

ادھر ملک کے مختلف حصوں میں پیش آنے والے دیگر واقعات میں دریائے یاسین سے ریسکیو حکام نے 11 لاشیں نکال لی ہیں اور اندھیرے کی وجہ سے امدادی کارروائیوں میں مشکلات کا سامنا ہے۔ کوہستان اسکینڈل میں احتساب عدالت پشاور نے ملزم کیشئر مشرف شاہ کی پلی بارگین کی درخواست پر تحریری فیصلہ جاری کر دیا ہے۔ مزید برآں، کراچی کے نارتھ ناظم آباد میں میر رضا کے دوست کے ریسٹورنٹ کی ایک برانچ سیل کر کے ریکارڈ ضبط کر لیا گیا ہے جبکہ بند کورائی پولیس اسٹیشن کے گیٹ پر نامعلوم دہشت گردوں نے بارودی پک اپ گاڑی ٹکرائی اور فائرنگ کی جس کے نتیجے میں نقصانات کی اطلاعات ہیں۔

stories.title: Eleven Killed as Passenger Van Plunges Into River in Ghizer
stories.summary:
At least 11 people lost their lives and multiple others were injured when a passenger van plummeted into the Yasin River in the Ghizer District of Gilgit-Baltistan. The vehicle was travelling from Gilgit toward Hundur in the upper Yasin Valley when the driver lost control near Morkah Bridge. Initial reports from rescue teams indicated a lower casualty count, but the death toll steadily climbed as recovery operations progressed in the fast-flowing water.

Local authorities and police confirmed that the victims, which included women and an infant, were primarily residents of the Yasin Valley. The injured survivors were promptly transferred for medical attention to local medical facilities, including Gupis Civil Hospital and a hospital in Gahkuch. Emergency responders noted that nighttime darkness severely hindered the search and rescue efforts, necessitating additional water rescue personnel dispatched from Gilgit.

Gilgit-Baltistan Chief Minister Amjad Hussain expressed deep sorrow over the tragedy, instructing local administrators and health departments to mobilize all available resources for the injured. He emphasized the importance of strict monitoring to ensure proper medical care and prevent any operational negligence during the aftermath. An official investigation has been launched to determine the exact cause of the accident.

The incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding transport safety in the region, following a series of recent fatal crashes across Pakistan. Earlier transport accidents on major motorways and mountain passes have prompted authorities, including the National Highways and Motorway Police, to enforce stricter oversight regarding vehicle overloading, valid fitness certificates, and transit regulations.

stories.title: Police Security Withdrawn From Ministers and Lawmakers Across Gujrat District
stories.summary:
District police in Gujrat have withdrawn security personnel previously assigned to various ministers, lawmakers, and former legislators from both the PML-Q and PML-N parties. Official sources report that a total of 30 policemen were recalled on merit without discrimination. Among them, two officers were removed from PML-N ex-MNA Chaudhry Abid Raza Kotla, while the remaining 28 were recalled from PML-Q political figures. The affected PML-Q politicians include Federal Minister for Overseas Pakistanis Chaudhry Salik Hussain, Punjab Minister for Industries and Commerce Chaudhry Shafay Hussain, MNA Chaudhry Ilyas, MNA Chaudhry Hussain Elahi, MPA Musa Elahi, and MPA Khalid Asghar Ghural.

The decision to strip these political figures of their security cover was finalized during a recent meeting of the District Intelligence Committee, adhering to standard operating procedures set by the provincial home department. Local administration officials explained that the committee reviewed the local security environment and determined that these individuals faced no active threats, making permanent police details unwarranted. Authorities noted that while politicians are not entitled to continuous protection, security will still be provided on a case-by-case basis whenever federal or provincial ministers visit Gujrat.

The move drew criticism from affected politicians, with MPA Musa Elahi publicly condemning the action as a reflection of the ruling administration's mentality. Observers note that the withdrawal from senior PML-Q leaders follows a public verbal clash between Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz and Federal Minister Salik Hussain, which stemmed from the latter's allegations of corruption within the Punjab government and a subsequent defamation notice sent to him.

stories.title: Automobile Assemblers Struggle to Obtain Copies of New Policy Documents
stories.summary:
Automobile assemblers in Pakistan have expressed frustration over their inability to access the newly announced auto policy for the 2026-2031 period. Raziur Rehman, head of the Pakistan Automotive Manufacturers Association (PAMA), stated that despite formal requests to the Ministry of Industries, the official document has not been shared with industry representatives. Rehman criticized the lack of transparency, noting that ambiguity surrounding the policy is harming the industry by stalling inventories and discouraging customer purchases, while expressing bewilderment at the apparent government secrecy.

The association noted that the final policy underwent drastic changes following the last industry consultations held in June by the industries ministry and the Engineering Development Board. Industry representatives also pointed out persistent challenges, including the rising import of used cars, mandatory export requirements that clash with high production costs, and a lack of free trade agreements with major vehicle-importing nations. These factors continue to obstruct export potential despite ongoing appeals to policymakers.

Meanwhile, recent sales figures indicate mixed performance across the broader automotive sector. Total cumulative sales for cars, light commercial vehicles, pickups, and SUVs reached 74,898 units during the first four months of fiscal year 2027, driven by a 41 percent year-on-year increase last month. Major assemblers reported varying results, with Atlas Honda achieving record motorcycle sales, Pakistan Suzuki reporting substantial gains in Swift and Alto models, and Indus Motor Company and Hyundai Nishat experiencing fluctuating monthly figures.

stories.title: FBR Mandates Electronic Monitoring Systems for Tea Industry by December 10
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has issued a directive requiring all registered entities involved in tea manufacturing, blending, and packing to install electronic production monitoring systems by December 10. This mandate applies to black tea, green tea, flavoured tea, tea bags, instant tea, tea extracts, and premixes containing milk powder or sugar, across all retail packaging types such as sachets, pouches, cartons, jars, tins, and bulk packs. The order also extends to toll and contract packers.

Under Sales Tax General Order (STGO) No. 35 of 2026, manufacturers must install barcode scanners, counting sensors, and related hardware and software on every packing line after the retail pack is filled and sealed. The system will electronically record production in real time and transmit the data to the FBR. The technology will read unique, machine-readable barcodes printed on each pack to identify stock-keeping units (SKUs) and count them based on approved master data using FBR-authorized vendors.

The FBR has identified 14 registered manufacturers and packers for this initiative, including Tapal Tea, Mezan Tea, Islamabad Tea Company, Alpha Tea, Leader Tea, Top Tea Company, Kohistan Foods, Quality Products, Noor Tea Co., Ahbaab Impex, DK Products (Pvt) Ltd, Kamal Foods, Raaz Industries (Pvt) Ltd, and Eastern Products (Pvt) Ltd. Chief Commissioners Inland Revenue have been instructed to appoint dedicated focal persons to coordinate the rollout.

Manufacturers have been given 15 days from the order date to ensure every product has a unique barcode corresponding to its brand, blend, weight, and packaging type. Furthermore, product details must be registered with an authorized vendor seven days prior to packing any new or altered product. The FBR aims to address the over Rs3 trillion sales tax collection gap through this digitization effort.

stories.title: Mobilink Bank Agrees to Acquire Controlling Stake in Apna Microfinance Bank
stories.summary:
Mobilink Bank has entered into a sale-purchase agreement to acquire an 82.51 per cent shareholding in the Pakistan Stock Exchange-listed Apna Microfinance Bank Ltd. The transaction remains subject to necessary legal and regulatory approvals.

The formal agreement was signed on Thursday by Mobilink Bank President and Chief Executive Haaris M. Chaudhary and Apna Microfinance Bank Chairman Muhammad Akram Shahid. Following the completion of the acquisition, Apna Bank customers will officially transition into the Mobilink Bank network, with uninterrupted access to their accounts and services throughout the integration process.

Mobilink Bank Chairman and JazzWorld CEO Aamir Ibrahim noted that the acquisition broadens the group's financial services reach—which currently encompasses JazzCash, JazzSure Insurance, and FikrFree—into agricultural and micro-enterprise banking. Mr. Chaudhary emphasized that leadership is committed to ensuring a smooth transition for all affected customers.

Nazish Ali, Acting CEO of Apna Microfinance Bank, stated that the agreement signifies a major milestone for the institution. She expressed confidence that integrating with Mobilink Bank will grant their customer base enhanced digital infrastructure, broader institutional capabilities, and a wider array of financial services.

stories.title: PSX Drops Below 178,000 Amid Profit-Taking and Political Uncertainty
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) experienced a bearish session on Thursday, slipping below the key 180,000 threshold as investors engaged in profit-taking for the second consecutive day amid cautious sentiment and domestic political uncertainty.

The benchmark KSE-100 index fell 1,710.04 points, or 0.95 per cent, to finish the day at 177,373.76 points. The market initially showed strength, climbing nearly 1,200 points to an intraday peak of 180,310, but the gains were wiped out by midday as selling pressure mounted across major index-heavy equities.

Heavyweights such as United Bank, Fauji Fertiliser, Hub Power, Lucky Cement, Systems Ltd, National Bank, Meezan Bank, Pakistan Petroleum, Askari Bank, and Bank Al-Habib acted as major laggards, collectively stripping 1,047 points from the index. Market participation also contracted, with trading volume dropping 14.23 per cent to 1.07 billion shares and turnover sliding 24.33 per cent to Rs31.6 billion. WorldCall Telecom topped the volume charts with 190.6 million shares traded.

In broader market developments, the Pakistan Automotive Manufacturers Association reported that national automobile sales rose to 21,635 units in October compared to September's 10,939 units, bringing cumulative sales for the period to 63,507 units. Additionally, Attock Refinery was included in the MSCI Frontier Markets Standard Index, raising Pakistan's representation to 30 stocks, while Flying Cement and Pakistan Oxygen were removed from the MSCI Small Cap Index.

stories.title: Truck Crash and Fire in UAE Fujairah Emirate Leaves 14 Dead
stories.summary:
A severe collision and subsequent fire involving a truck and multiple other vehicles in the United Arab Emirates resulted in 14 fatalities and 30 injuries, marking one of the country's deadliest road accidents.

According to Fujairah Police, the incident occurred shortly before midnight on Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road near the entrance to the emirate of Fujairah. The truck driver lost control of the vehicle, colliding with another automobile before overturning and striking several cars that had halted due to slow-moving traffic. The impact triggered a major fire in the truck, which quickly spread to the surrounding damaged vehicles.

Emergency responders, civil defense teams, and police rushed to the scene to extinguish the flames, secure the location, and transport the wounded to hospitals. Among the injured, 15 have since been discharged, while the remaining 15 continue to receive medical treatment. The casualties include Emirati nationals, and authorities are utilizing DNA testing to positively identify certain victims.

The Indian consulate in Dubai confirmed that Indian citizens were among those killed in the tragedy, stating that diplomatic officials have contacted the grieving families and are cooperating with local authorities to offer support. The UAE interior ministry and police continue to manage the aftermath of the disaster.

stories.title: Trump Rules Out Iran Deal, Directs Vice President to Target Corruption
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump declared on Thursday that the United States has no need for a diplomatic agreement with Iran, shifting his administration's focus away from resolving the ongoing eight-month conflict. Writing on social media, Trump asserted that those diplomatic opportunities have passed, noting that Washington possesses Iranian financial assets and strategic waterways like the Strait of Hormuz. This announcement followed reports that Vice President JD Vance was considering direct peace talks with a senior Iranian security official, after Vance previously blamed the costly war for Republican losses in the midterm elections.

In place of peace negotiations, Trump directed Vice President Vance to pivot toward a domestic portfolio focusing on alleged fraud and corruption within Democratic-run cities and states. The president claimed that correcting this supposed criminal activity could swiftly balance the national budget, attributing systemic corruption to Democratic leadership. Meanwhile, Vance's office did not immediately provide a response to requests for comment regarding the president's new directives.

International reactions to the ongoing conflict continued as Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan urged both the United States and Iran to restart negotiations immediately. Meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on the sidelines of a UN climate conference in Antalya, Turkey, Erdogan emphasized the necessity of finding common ground to end the hostilities. The current Middle East war commenced on February 28 following US-Israeli strikes that resulted in the assassination of Iran's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, prompting retaliatory missile and drone attacks across the region from Tehran.

stories.title: Putin Rejects Ukraine Compromise During Kremlin Talks with US Envoys
stories.summary:
Russian President Vladimir Putin stated on Thursday that Moscow will not soften its hardline demands to end the conflict in Ukraine, despite offering a short-term ceasefire in a vital frontline city. During a televised Kremlin meeting with visiting US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, Putin dismissed the possibility of establishing demilitarized zones or accepting foreign peacekeeping troops, asserting that such deployments would merely prolong the war. The discussions followed two days of preliminary talks in Abu Dhabi aimed at resolving Europe's most severe military conflict since World War II.

While maintaining rigid territorial demands regarding parts of Ukraine claimed as annexed by Russia, Putin agreed to permit European representatives to participate in the next round of peace negotiations. US envoy Witkoff confirmed the inclusion of European partners after meeting with the Russian leader, though Putin maintained that Washington must coordinate with European allies to clarify their intentions regarding peace or continued hostilities. Moscow has consistently sought to position these talks within the broader framework of European security architecture.

Following their departure from the Kremlin, Kushner and Witkoff traveled directly to Dublin to confer with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, who was attending a European summit. In the Irish capital, Zelensky highlighted ongoing challenges, including recent operational restrictions placed on the Starshield satellite internet service that negatively impact Ukrainian frontline communications and drone interception capabilities. Russian forces continue to occupy substantial portions of eastern and southern Ukraine in addition to Crimea, which was annexed in 2014.

stories.title: Peshawar Police Enforce Total Ban on Private Dispute Resolution Jirgas
stories.summary:
Peshawar police have enacted a formal ban on private jirgas, which are informal dispute-resolution gatherings, and issued strict warnings to local wedding halls, hotels, and restaurants against hosting such events on their properties.

Capital City Police Officer (CCPO) Dr Mian Saeed Ahmad confirmed the directive, stating that violations of the order will result in immediate legal action against both organizers and venue providers. The decision follows multiple complaints and incidents that highlighted severe issues tied to these unregulated meetings.

Authorities stated that private jirgas frequently promote local gun culture, coerce participants into depositing large surety amounts, and frequently culminate in violent clashes at the venue. Furthermore, private organizers often charge exorbitant fees and demand lavish meals, placing an unnecessary financial strain on the disputing parties.

The ban was implemented because the government has already established Dispute Resolution Committees (DRCs) that operate under police supervision free of charge. Unlike private jirgas, which CCPO Ahmad noted have devolved into commercial enterprises linked to land grabbing, DRCs provide an independent, transparent alternative for community members.

This regulatory enforcement aims to curb illegal coercion, eliminate financial exploitation, and reduce gun violence in the region. Police have also stated they will actively recover illegally charged money and return it to victims while cracking down on individuals who provide space for unauthorized gatherings.

stories.title: Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi Floats Referendum on New Administrative Units
stories.summary:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi proposed holding a public referendum on Thursday to decide whether to create new administrative provinces, suggesting the vote would definitively conclude a long-standing political debate. Speaking to journalists at the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency in Lahore, Naqvi assured political parties that they would be consulted before any concrete steps are taken. He argued that survey reports indicate smaller administrative units could improve governance, and noted that opponents of the proposal should present viable alternative solutions for the public to consider.

The proposal follows recent political friction surrounding administrative reforms, with Defence Minister Khawaja Asif supporting smaller units based on administrative efficiency, while the Pakistan Peoples Party opposes division within Sindh. Addressing broader political dialogue, Naqvi noted alignment with PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari's calls for a political reset to confront economic challenges. Additionally, Naqvi acknowledged that corruption remains widespread throughout the country and stressed the collective responsibility of the government to address and eliminate it wherever it occurs.

During his media interaction, Naqvi also addressed several other prominent national issues. He defended recent notices issued by the Capital Development Authority regarding the residence of JUI-F chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, clarifying that the enforcement campaign was routine and not targeted at specific individuals. Furthermore, the interior minister dismissed circulating rumors of a behind-the-scenes political deal involving detained PTI founder Imran Khan, emphasizing that any relief for Khan and his family will be determined strictly through the legal court system.

stories.title: Pakistan Lowers Petrol and High-Speed Diesel Prices Starting November 13
stories.summary:
Fuel consumers in Pakistan are set to experience slight financial relief at pump stations beginning November 13, following an official reduction in petroleum prices. According to announcements made in Islamabad by journalist Wasim Iqbal, the ex-depot retail rate of petrol has been lowered by Rs3 per litre, shifting the cost downward from Rs335 to Rs332. In a similar adjustment, the price of High-Speed Diesel (HSD) has been decreased by Rs4 per litre, moving the price tag from Rs364 to Rs360.

Regulatory authorities attributed these price adjustments to broader global market developments alongside shifts in Platts pricing benchmarks, associated premiums, and incidental costs. Internationally, benchmark prices for petrol declined from USD 93.55 per barrel down to USD 91.64 per barrel. Meanwhile, the premium including freight costs rose to USD 28.76 per barrel. For High-Speed Diesel, international benchmark prices dropped from USD 96.33 to USD 94.16 per barrel.

On an ex-refinery basis, the cost for petrol dropped to Rs237.31 per litre from its previous level of Rs240.65, while the ex-refinery cost for HSD fell to Rs252.08 per litre compared to Rs255.88 previously. These domestic reductions reflect shifting global crude values while local duties and profit margins remain entirely unaffected.

Government levies and fixed profit margins for both petrol and High-Speed Diesel remain completely unchanged. Each fuel type carries a Petroleum Levy of Rs80 per litre, a Climate Support Levy of Rs5 per litre, and fixed profit margins of Rs9.98 per litre for dealers alongside Rs7.87 per litre for oil marketing companies. Furthermore, the Inland Freight Equalisation Margin remains fixed at Rs8.17 per litre for petrol and Rs5.10 per litre for HSD.

stories.title: Finance Minister Aurangzeb Urges International Investment in Pakistani Sovereign Sukuk
stories.summary:
Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb called upon international investors to increase their participation in Pakistan’s sovereign Sukuk, noting that foreign capital inflows into these Shariah-compliant instruments remain underwhelming. Speaking in Islamabad at a ceremony commemorating the achievement of Rs10 trillion in sovereign Sukuk issuance, the minister highlighted that total Sukuk issuance surged by 113 percent year-on-year in 2026 to reach Rs4.4 trillion, up from approximately Rs2 trillion a year prior. He noted that the five-year compound annual growth rate stands at roughly 22 percent compared to nearly Rs761 billion in 2020.

Aurangzeb explained that the government has introduced hybrid and short-term Shariah-compliant instruments with maturities ranging from three to six months to diversify financing sources and establish a comprehensive yield curve. He also pointed out that hybrid government Sukuks combine different Islamic structures to provide greater flexibility in utilizing state-owned assets. Despite positive inflows through Special Convertible Rupee Accounts into conventional instruments like Treasury Bills and Pakistan Investment Bonds, foreign investment in Sukuk has lagged behind expectations, prompting the minister to urge banks, brokers, and market dealers to actively promote them abroad.

To broaden the domestic investor base, the minister advocated for expanding retail participation through digital channels, enabling individual citizens to invest amounts as low as Rs5,000. Addressing corporate debt, Aurangzeb revealed that the Ministry of Power has issued a mandate to the National Debt Company to launch the nation's first-ever listed corporate Sukuk. He emphasized that institutions such as the State Bank of Pakistan, Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, Pakistan Stock Exchange, and Central Depository Company must coordinate closely to build a robust Islamic capital market ecosystem.

Concluding his address, Aurangzeb underscored the importance of applying Ijtihad and informed reasoning rooted in the Quran and Sunnah to navigate modern financial challenges. He encouraged religious scholars and economic experts to focus on common ground rather than differences. Such cooperative efforts, he stated, are essential for strengthening Pakistan's Islamic finance landscape and ensuring sustainable economic progress.

stories.title: Iran Reports Four Oil Tankers Struck by Explosions in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
Four oil tankers were struck by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz after entering restricted areas and ignoring official warnings, according to statements released by Iran’s military on Thursday. The incidents occurred despite a recent rebound in maritime traffic and falling oil prices driven by expectations of a de-escalation in the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy stated that two supertankers were disabled on Wednesday after hitting naval mines along what authorities designated an unauthorized route, state media broadcasting video footage of the blasts.

Iranian state television reported that two additional tankers struck mines on Thursday afternoon while navigating the eastern portion of the Strait of Hormuz. According to official reports, these vessels had similarly ignored prior warnings and disabled their radar systems before entering the restricted zone and catching fire. These events follow a shift in how the IRGC Navy reports maritime incidents, moving from explicitly claiming direct attacks earlier in the US-Israeli conflict to attributing recent vessel fires to floating naval mines.

Independent maritime monitoring agencies have documented similar incidents with varying accounts of the causes. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency reported that a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile roughly 14 nautical miles northwest of Ras Al-Khaimah while exiting the strait on Wednesday. That strike ignited a fire in the ship's engine room, prompting a full evacuation of the crew and ongoing firefighting operations.

Shipping traffic through the strategic waterway has faced continuous security threats since the conflict began in late February. Data compiled by the Washington Institute for Near East Policy indicates that at least 10 ships were struck during the first ten days of November alone. This followed a high tally of 37 attacks recorded in October, marking the worst monthly total since hostilities originally commenced.

stories.title: Pakistan Inaugurates PMIF-2026 to Showcase Mineral Wealth and Attract Investment
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar inaugurated the third Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum (PMIF-2026) in Islamabad on Thursday, calling for international investment, technology transfer, and industrial cooperation. With representatives from over 60 countries in attendance, Dar emphasized that Pakistan aims to transition from exporting raw minerals to establishing domestic processing, refining, and manufacturing capabilities. He noted that mineral development is critical for diversifying exports, strengthening the industrial base, and creating employment.

Highlighting the nation's geological wealth, Dar pointed to significant copper and gold reserves along the Tethyan Metallogenic Belt in western Pakistan, alongside deposits of iron ore, chromite, lead, zinc, coal, rock salt, marble, gypsum, and gemstones. He cited the RekoDiq copper-gold project in Balochistan as a prime model of collaboration involving Barrick Gold, federal state-owned enterprises, and the provincial government. Dar stressed that the government seeks to develop complete value chains supported by the National Mineral Policy, the Pakistan Investment Policy 2023, and the Special Investment Facilitation Council, while cultivating strong economic ties with China, Saudi Arabia, Gulf nations, Turkey, and Central Asian partners.

Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb, speaking at the forum, outlined Pakistan's broader macroeconomic progress aimed at achieving sustainable, export-led growth. He reported that the country reduced its twin deficit from roughly 12.5 percent of Gross Domestic Product to 2.6 percent by June 2026, achieved a 22-year low fiscal deficit, and recorded primary surpluses for three consecutive years. Furthermore, foreign exchange reserves reached a historic high of USD 21.5 billion, which covers over three months of imports. Aurangzeb noted that these buffers helped the nation withstand economic shocks such as the October 2025 floods and regional Gulf conflicts.

To solidify these economic gains, Aurangzeb emphasized that Pakistan is pursuing deep structural reforms across taxation, energy, public finance, and tariffs, while actively privatizing state-owned enterprises. The government projects a four percent economic growth rate for the current fiscal year, following nearly 3.7 percent growth the previous year. By keeping export financing rates between 4.5 and 6 percent and lowering taxes for exporters, the administration hopes to avoid import-driven balance-of-payments pressures and establish long-term economic stability.

stories.title: Government Directs SBP to Prepare Working Paper for Raast QR MDR Scheme
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has instructed the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) to create a working paper for the approval of the Raast QR Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) scheme. This move aims to maintain the growth of digital payments following a fourfold rise in active merchants, reaching 2.03 million under the Prime Minister's Cashless Pakistan initiative. Minister of State for Railways and Finance Bilal Azhar Kayani led a high-level follow-up meeting at the Finance Division to review progress and refine the framework.

Several key advancements were highlighted during the meeting, including the transition of all Asaan Assignment Account payments to the Raast system starting November 16, with trained Drawing and Disbursing Officers. Additionally, Raast QR codes have been placed on over 45 million gas and electricity bills, and all National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) centers have been equipped for digital transactions. Overall digital payment volumes have doubled in a single year.

To ensure continued expansion, the Minister of State will meet with bank presidents and CEOs in Karachi to discuss stakeholder collaboration. Furthermore, the SBP has been tasked with assessing macroeconomic indicators, such as the ratio of RTGS-processed payments to GDP, to measure broader economic outcomes effectively.

The meeting drew numerous high-level participants from both the public and private sectors. Attendees included senior officials from the Finance Division, SBP, Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication, and NADRA, alongside leaders from Easypaisa Digital Bank, JazzCash, Bank Alfalah, JS Bank, and Karandaaz Pakistan. Authorities stressed the necessity of strengthening coordination to meet national digital goals.

stories.title: Federal Minister for Petroleum Meets Global Mining Executives at PMIF
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik engaged in bilateral discussions with international mining and investment leaders during the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum (PMIF). The meetings emphasized Pakistan's dedication to securing foreign investment and forging global partnerships within the mineral sector. The minister met separately with Barrick Mining Corporation Chairman John Thornton, Weir CEO Andrew Neilson, Trafigura MENA Head of Metals and Minerals Ibrahim El Gazzar, and Çalik Holding CEO Mustafa Aksoy, alongside a delegation led by Ivanhoe Mines' Robert Friedland.

During the talks, Andrew Neilson stated that Weir wants to expand its footprint in Pakistan's mining sector beyond its current involvement at Reko Diq. Ibrahim El Gazzar mentioned Trafigura's strong interest in the nation's Zinc-Barite project, as well as potential ventures in LPG, bonded storage, and refinery sectors. John Thornton noted his appreciation for visiting the country, highlighting Barrick Mining Corporation's ongoing engagement.

A major highlight of the forum was a signing ceremony witnessed by the petroleum minister between Ivanhoe Mines and Mari Minerals. The agreement establishes a partnership to explore copper and gold deposits in Chagai, Balochistan, allowing both entities to evaluate the area's mineral potential and develop its resources.

Minister Malik praised the rising international interest in Pakistan's mineral resources. He underscored that the PMIF serves as a vital bridge connecting global investors with lucrative opportunities, facilitating cooperative ventures, and unlocking the country's extensive mineral wealth.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Raises Currency Transaction Report Threshold to Rs3 Million
stories.summary:
Acting on federal government instructions, the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) raised the minimum threshold for reporting Currency Transaction Reports (CTR) to its Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU). Effective immediately, the new limit is set at Rs3 million under the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010. This replaces the previous Rs2 million threshold established in January 2015.

The SBP formally communicated the revision to banks and regulated entities via a circular letter. The change follows a notification issued by the Minister of Finance and originates from a decision by the National Executive Committee on Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT). The committee utilized powers granted under Section 2(xi) of the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010, to modify the older Finance Division notification from 2015.

Regulated entities are mandated to ensure full compliance with the updated threshold requirements. Furthermore, financial institutions must maintain comprehensive records of both domestic and international transactions, including inquiry results regarding complex or unusual large transactions, for a minimum duration of ten years.

Institutions are also required to retain all records concerning filed Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and CTRs for the same ten-year period starting from the completion date of the transaction, ensuring regulatory accountability and transparency across the financial sector.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Advocates for Grant-Based Climate Finance at COP31
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif urged global leaders to adopt grant-based climate financing and expand adaptation funds during his national statement at the Antalya Leaders Summit of COP31. He emphasized that vulnerable developing nations require immediate financial assistance through mechanisms like public-private partnerships that do not exacerbate their existing debt burdens. Resilience and adaptation funds, he noted, are essential survival tools for struggling economies facing escalating climate disasters.

Recalling Pakistan's severe climate challenges, the prime minister referenced the 2022 floods that submerged one-third of the country, affected 33 million individuals, killed over 1,700 people, and caused more than $30 billion in economic damages. He also shared the tragic story of a young man affected by the August 2025 flash floods in Buner to illustrate the heavy human toll borne by populations least responsible for global emissions. He reiterated that climate change respects no borders and demands unified action.

Highlighting domestic clean energy milestones, the prime minister stated that Pakistan added over 20 gigawatts of distributed solar capacity in two years, with clean sources now comprising nearly 55 percent of its energy mix. He also mentioned progress in nuclear energy, including the recent dome placement for the 1,200-megawatt Chashma-5 Nuclear Power Plant, alongside goals to cut projected emissions by up to 50 percent by 2035 through electric mobility and other measures.

Concluding his address, the prime minister stressed water security, asserting that water must never be weaponized against downstream populations and that water-sharing agreements must be strictly honored. He thanked Türkiye for hosting COP31 and for its historical support during major floods, while urging the international community to judge the success of the summit by tangible actions and protected lives.

stories.title: Distributed Solar Adoption Drives Down Gas Output in Pakistan
stories.summary:
According to the Renewables First Pakistan Energy Market Review, Pakistan's indigenous natural gas production declined by 8 percent in the 2025 fiscal year. Concurrently, the consumption of imported Regasified Liquefied Natural Gas in the power sector dropped by 24 percent. This shift was largely driven by the expansion of distributed solar generation, which displaced expensive fuel-based electricity and reduced dependence on imported fossil fuels.

The report notes that local gas production fell due to the depletion of mature fields and limited exploration activity. Excess LNG availability also led to the curtailment of domestic gas production. LNG imports decreased by 4 percent to 8.7 million tonnes of oil equivalent. Meanwhile, higher industrial activity pushed RLNG consumption in other sectors up by 54 percent, and industrial gas consumption grew by 3.6 percent, driven mainly by export industries and cement production.

Distributed solar has helped Pakistan avoid approximately $15 billion in fossil fuel imports by the 2026 fiscal year, easing pressure on foreign exchange reserves. The analysis estimates that solar panels and inverters imported for $8.9 billion have helped avoid nearly $14.7 billion in fuel imports. Further investments could bring cumulative savings to about $124 billion between FY17 and FY50, saving roughly nine dollars in fossil fuel imports for every dollar invested.

Other energy sectors also experienced shifts during FY25. Oil supplies increased by 15 percent, while domestic crude production fell by 12 percent, forcing refineries to import 77 percent of their crude requirements. Petroleum consumption in the power sector plummeted by 77 percent. Indigenous coal production saw its first reduction since FY15, falling by 3 percent, while coal imports rose to 4.6 million tonnes of oil equivalent to meet industrial demand.

stories.title: Sui Gas Utilities Petition Regulator for Price Hikes in FY27
stories.summary:
State-owned utilities Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited and Sui Southern Gas Company Limited have submitted petitions to the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority. They are seeking increases in their average prescribed gas prices for the fiscal year 2026-27, with the changes requested to take effect retrospectively from July 1.

Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited has requested an increase of Rs10 per million British thermal units, which would raise its average prescribed price from Rs1,702 to Rs1,712.40. This request includes Rs60.147 billion in liquefied natural gas service costs, placing the cost of LNG for the company at Rs471.16 per MMBtu.

Sui Southern Gas Company Limited has asked for a much larger increase of Rs366.75 per MMBtu, aiming to push its average prescribed price to Rs2,071.75. Both gas utilities pointed to higher international crude oil prices as a contributing factor for needing price adjustments.

Additionally, Sui Northern noted that limited availability of indigenous gas during the winter season will require additional arrangements, estimating that 16 LNG cargoes will be needed to meet demand. The regulatory authority will hold public hearings on these applications before making a final decision regarding the requested price adjustments.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Seeks Ministries' Replies on PLI Funds
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court directed the Ministries of Finance and Communications to submit responses regarding a petition concerning Rs 48 billion in Postal Life Insurance policyholders' funds. Justice Arbab Muhammad Tahir heard the public interest constitutional petition filed by the Judicial Activism Panel during a Thursday session.

The petitioner's counsel raised concerns about the fate of the Rs 48 billion belonging to government servants, retired employees, pensioners, widows, and other citizens who invested savings in Postal Life Insurance policies. Matured insurance claims have reportedly been delayed or left unpaid due to the stated non-availability of funds. Officials from Pakistan Post and the federal communications minister have acknowledged that the money remains with the Finance Division.

The legal challenge references the Auditor-General of Pakistan's Special Study Report for 2022-23, which uncovered financial and administrative irregularities during the conversion of Postal Life Insurance into Postal Life Insurance Company Limited. The report stated that out of Rs 8 billion released by the Finance Division in 2021-22, Rs 3.1 billion went toward claims while Rs 4.9 billion was surrendered, alongside unsettled claims totaling approximately Rs 7.99 billion and un-transferred premiums.

The petition argues that individual insurance premiums cannot automatically be treated as federal government revenue under Article 78(1) of the Constitution and should fall under the Public Account. It invokes multiple constitutional articles and the Insurance Ordinance of 2000, asking for an independent forensic audit, disclosure of financial records, and the timely settlement of matured claims to protect the rights of ordinary citizens.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz Halts German Investments Amid Growing Cost Pressures
stories.summary:
German automaker Mercedes-Benz announced that it will halt all investments in Germany and consider plant closures. The decision highlights ongoing challenges within the country's automotive sector, which has been impacted by intense Chinese competition and high operational costs. Last month, Mercedes became the third major German car manufacturer to lower its financial outlook for the year.

Company management has been engaged in discussions with staff representatives to negotiate cost reductions. However, with little progress made during these talks, leadership decided to adopt a stricter approach. Michael Schiebe, a member of the executive board, stated in an internal intranet interview that the board jointly agreed to freeze all future investments at German sites.

Schiebe noted that despite numerous intensive discussions, management could not find a viable path forward with labor unions. As a result, the manufacturer stated it is compelled to carefully evaluate which German sites may face closure if cost structures cannot be successfully altered.

stories.title: Australia Captain Pat Cummins Strongly Denies 2018 Sandpaper Plot Claims
stories.summary:
Australian Test captain Pat Cummins has firmly rejected allegations made in Usman Khawaja's new autobiography that all players knew about the ball-tampering plot during a 2018 Test against South Africa. Speaking in Sydney on Friday, Cummins labeled assertions that he and others were architects of the sandpaper scheme as utter nonsense and completely untrue.

The scandal dates back to 2018 when then-captain Steve Smith, vice-captain David Warner, and opening batsman Cameron Bancroft received significant suspensions from Cricket Australia for bringing the sport into disrepute. Cummins expressed surprise at Khawaja's admission regarding telling Bancroft to be cautious, emphasizing that such actions do not align with the team culture rebuilt over the past eight years.

While acknowledging Khawaja's right to share his story, Cummins criticized his teammate and friend for being casual with the lives and reputations of others. The skipper stated he had no recollection of discussions regarding collective responsibility for the incident and was unaware which two players supposedly rejected such a call.

Despite receiving legal advice that certain statements in the book were likely defamatory, Cummins confirmed he will not pursue legal action against Khawaja. He stressed the importance of moving past the events of eight years ago and drawing a line under the controversy.

stories.title: England Reach Nations League Quarter-Finals While Italy Defeats France
stories.summary:
England secured their progression to the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals following a 2-1 victory over Croatia at Wembley Stadium on Thursday. Harry Kane marked his record-breaking 126th appearance for the national team by converting a crucial penalty after a VAR review, bringing his international goal tally to 92. Morgan Rogers had initially opened the scoring for England in the first half before Petar Sucic equalized for Croatia following an error by Jarell Quansah.

Thomas Tuchel's side advanced to 12 points in Group A3, setting up a decisive group-stage finale against Spain in Madrid. Spain maintained their top position with 15 points after defeating the Czech Republic 2-0 in Prague, courtesy of an Alex Baena penalty and a late strike from Marc Pubill. The Czech side finished the match with ten men following the red card issued to captain Ladislav Krejci.

In Group A1, Italy handed Zinedine Zidane his first defeat as France coach by coming from behind to secure a 3-1 victory in Milan. Despite France taking an early lead through Michael Olise after a defensive error by Gianluigi Donnarumma, Italy responded with goals from Francesco Pio Esposito and Davide Frattesi. Esposito later added a second penalty to seal the win.

With this result, Italy moved ahead of France at the top of Group A1 on head-to-head records, as both teams sit on ten points ahead of their final fixtures. Meanwhile, Belgium kept their qualification hopes alive by defeating Turkiye 2-1 in Izmir, overcoming an opening goal from Arda Guler with strikes by Kevin De Bruyne and Charles De Ketelaere.

stories.title: بھکر میں نو سالہ بچی کو ہراساں کرنے والے ملزم مجاہد کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا
stories.summary:
صوبہ پنجاب کے شہر بھکر کے نواحی علاقے دریا خان میں نو سالہ کمسن بچی کے ساتھ نازیبا حرکات کرنے والے ملزم کو پولیس نے گرفتار کر کے اس کے خلاف باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا ہے۔ پولیس کے مطابق حراست میں لیے جانے والے ملزم کی شناخت مجاہد کے نام سے ہوئی ہے جو محلہ سنہری مسجد کا رہائشی ہے۔ واقعے کی اطلاع ملنے پر مقامی پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ملزم کو دبوچ لیا۔

ڈی پی او بھکر شاہد احمد چدھڑ نے اس واقعے پر سخت ردعمل دیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ بچوں اور خواتین کے خلاف ہونے والے تشدد، ہراسگی اور جنسی نوعیت کے جرائم کے خلاف پولیس کی پالیسی 'زیرو ٹالرنس' پر مبنی ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ کمسن بچوں اور خواتین کا تحفظ پولیس کی اولین ترجیح ہے اور اس قبیح فعل میں ملوث عناصر کے ساتھ سختی سے نمٹا جائے گا۔ قانون ششکنی کرنے والوں کو کیفر کردار تک پہنچایا جائے گا تاکہ ایسے واقعات کی روک تھام کی جا سکے۔

stories.title: رانا ثنا اللہ کا کہنا ہے کہ اداروں سے دوری ناممکن ہے
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم کے مشیر برائے سیاسی امور رانا ثنا اللہ نے ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ یہ سازشی نظریہ غلط ہے کہ بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ملاقات 28 ویں ترمیم کے لیے کروائی گئی۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ اداروں سے دوری نہ کبھی ہوئی ہے اور نہ ہو سکے گی، اور ہمارے اعتماد کی بنیادی وجہ وزیراعظم اور فیلڈ مارشل کی شخصیات ہیں۔ اس موقع پر دیگر سیاسی رہنماؤں کے بیانات بھی سامنے آئے جن میں پی ٹی آئی کے رہنما علی محمد خان نے بیرسٹر گوہر اور محسن نقوی کے درمیان رابطوں کی تصدیق کی، جبکہ تحریک انصاف کے سیکریٹری جنرل سلمان اکرم راجہ نے لطیف کھوسہ کے بیانات کو حقائق کے برعکس قرار دیا۔

متعدد دیگر اہم واقعات میں، دریائے یاسین سے ریسکیو حکام نے 11 افراد کی لاشیں نکالی ہیں جن میں دو کمسن بچے بھی شامل ہیں، اور اندھیرے کی وجہ سے آپریشن میں مشکلات پیش آئیں۔ پشاور میں کورائی پولیس اسٹیشن کے گیٹ پر نامعلوم دہشت گردوں نے بارودی پک اپ گاڑی ٹکرائی اور فائرنگ کی جس کے نتیجے میں دو شہری، کلیم اللہ اور بی بی لائبہ، شہید جبکہ تین ایف سی اہلکاروں سمیت کئی افراد زخمی ہو گئے۔ اس کے علاوہ، احتساب عدالت پشاور میں اپر کوہستان اسکینڈل کے ملزم کیشئر مشرف شاہ نے پلی بارگین کی درخواست دائر کر دی ہے، جس کا تحریری فیصلہ جج نے جاری کر دیا ہے۔

کراچی میں ان لینڈ ریونیو کے گریڈ 17 اور اس سے اوپر کے افسران کی صلاحیتیں جانچنے کے لیے انکم ٹیکس اور سیلز ٹیکس کے ٹیسٹ لیے گئے۔ نارتھ ناظم آباد میں میر رضا کے دوست اور پارٹنر کی ایک فوڈ چین برانچ کو سیل کر کے ریکارڈ ضبط کر لیا گیا۔ مزید برآں، سیکیورٹی ذرائع نے کلگام کے واقعے پر بھارتی میڈیا کے پروپیگنڈے کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے اسے فالس فلیگ کارروائی قرار دیا جو کسی سنجیدہ ردعمل کے قابل نہیں۔ ریلوے حکام کی جانب سے اعلان کیا گیا ہے کہ پشاور کے لیے کل نہ تو جعفر ایکسپریس روانہ ہوگی اور نہ ہی جناح پیپلز ٹرین چلے گی۔

stories.title: Mohsin Naqvi Advocates Public Referendum on New Provinces Issue in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi stated that seeking public opinion is the most effective approach to resolving the debate surrounding the establishment of new provinces in Pakistan. Speaking to media representatives at the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency in Lahore, Naqvi emphasized that every political party holds a distinct viewpoint on the matter, noting that the Pakistan Peoples Party maintains its own specific stance.

Naqvi stressed that governance decisions should not rely on disagreement, maintaining that consensus among major political allies, including the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz and the PPP, remains essential. The remarks followed recent discussions regarding a potential 28th Constitutional Amendment and a reported proposal to reorganize the country into 12 provinces. Proponents argue the restructuring would enhance administrative decentralization and resource distribution, while critics like PPP leader Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari have opposed the idea in Sindh, calling instead for a political reset.

In addition to provincial discussions, Naqvi addressed agency operations, announcing that the NCCIA complaint cell will integrate into the Pak ID platform. Highlighting resource constraints, he noted that the Punjab branch currently operates with only 61 personnel and requires staffing increases. He reiterated a strict stance against cyber blackmail and corruption within the interior ministry.

Addressing unrelated political queries regarding the PTI founder and his legal standing, Naqvi remarked that rumors offer short-lived media coverage and that individuals will receive whatever outcomes are determined by the courts. Government officials continue to evaluate administrative structures as part of broader governance considerations.

stories.title: کراچی میں پولیس کے مبینہ مقابلے، تین زخمیوں سمیت متعدد ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں پولیس کے مبینہ مقابلوں کے دوران تین ملزمان زخمی حالت میں پکڑے گئے جبکہ دو خواتین سمیت دیگر افراد کو بھی حراست میں لے لیا گیا۔ پولیس نے کارروائیوں کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، گاڑیاں، موٹرسائیکلیں، نقدی اور دیگر سامان برآمد کرنے کا دعویٰ کیا ہے۔

ڈیفنس کے علاقے میں سی آر اے پٹہ کے قریب مبینہ مقابلے کے بعد پولیس نے ایک زخمی ملزم خرم شہزاد عرف عرفان اشرف اور دو خواتین نسرین اختر عرف شہناز اور صغریٰ عرف پروین شوکت کو گرفتار کر لیا۔ اس موقع پر ملزم کا ایک اور ساتھی ارشد علی عرف لنگڑا بھی پکڑا گیا جبکہ دیگر چھ ساتھی فرار ہو گئے۔ گرفتار ملزمان کے ہمراہ ایک تین سالہ بچہ بھی موجود تھا، اور ان کے پاس سے ایک آلٹو کار، دو موٹرسائیکلیں، پستول، نقد رقم اور مصنوعی زیورات برآمد ہوئے۔

گلشن معمار کے علاقے جنجال گوٹھ میں بھی پولیس اور ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان مبینہ مقابلہ ہوا جس میں ایک ڈاکو سلیمان زخمی حالت میں پکڑا گیا۔ اسی طرح تیموریہ پولیس نے نارتھ ناظم آباد کی بلال کالونی میں مقابلے کے بعد پیر بخش عرف لال نامی ملزم کو زخمی حالت میں دبوچ لیا۔

تمام زخمی ملزمان کو طبی امداد کی فراہمی کے لیے جناح اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا۔ پولیس کے مطابق گلشن معمار اور تیموریہ کے واقعات میں پکڑے گئے ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، موبائل فون، نقدی اور موٹرسائیکلیں بھی قبضے میں لی گئی ہیں۔
